name: ORCAS RO 8 S
summary: ORCAS RO 8 S is a premium RO water purifier featuring a durable SS304 stainless steel body, tank, and frame for long-lasting performance and hygiene.
features: Premium SS304 stainless Steel body, storage tank, and frame for superior strength and durability.
Fully automatic Microcontroller-based PCB with SMPS for reliable and efficient operation.
Available in Normal and Normal + Hot variants.
SS Probe-based Automatic Water Level Controller for accurate water level management.
Bright LED status indicators for easy monitoring of purifier functions.
Bottom inlet and outlet design for neat and convenient installation.
Long-lasting stainless steel construction ensures excellent value with minimal maintenance.
Elegant, modern design that blends seamlessly with any kitchen interior.
Corrosion-resistant body with easy maintenance and excellent resale value.
Service-friendly design for quick and hassle-free maintenance.
extra: CONWAY UV + OZONE DLX, CONWAY UV + OZONE DLX (NORMAL & HOT), CONWAY UV DLX, CONWAY UV DLX (NORMAL & HOT)
